name: Replay old signed MUD file
baseline_note: B1/B2 accept: signature valid, no version check

name: Profile rollback v+1->v (returning controller)
baseline_note: B3 also rejects via last_update cache; B1/B2 accept

name: First-contact old-but-time-valid endorsed checkpoint
baseline_note: Honest result: witnesses bound freshness to the endorsed view, not global latestness. Freshness still bounded by valid_until/accept_window.

name: First-contact checkpoint beyond freshness window
baseline_note: Bounded staleness enforces rejection past window

name: Join with revoked device key
baseline_note: B1/B2/B3 have no per-device status: accept

name: Join with suspended device key
baseline_note: No baseline models suspension

name: Replay old onboarding transcript (reused R)
baseline_note: Commitment-reuse tracking (as in FIDEM) rejects

name: Replay transcript under a different checkpoint
baseline_note: Checkpoint digest bound in transcript

name: Leaked FIDEM class secret K_c
detail: B2 accepts any holder of K_c
baseline_note: ORBIT-MUD has no class-wide shared secret

name: Leaked ORBIT-MUD device key k_i
baseline_note: Blast radius = one revocable identity, not class

name: Impersonate another device after one k_i leak
baseline_note: Per-device PoP: cannot sign for a key not held

name: Inconsistent checkpoints to two controllers
detail: same size, different root at equal seq
baseline_note: Detection via checkpoint comparison, not prevention

name: Witnesses available in {0,1,2,3} (q=2 strong)
baseline_note: 2-of-3 quorum on first contact

name: Stale cached checkpoint within grace, log down
baseline_note: Bounded-staleness grace for returning controller

name: Stale checkpoint after grace interval
baseline_note: Past grace -> reject

name: Emergency suspension of healthcare gateway
baseline_note: Emergency flag in signed record; withdraw+deny

name: Duplicate endorsements from one witness id
baseline_note: Quorum counts distinct configured identities

name: Unanchored checkpoint under ledger-strict policy
baseline_note: On-chain commitment required for admission

name: Signed forked checkpoint refused by ordered ledger
baseline_note: Ledger total order upgrades equivocation from detectable to rejected at admission

name: Duplicated organisation endorsement on-chain
baseline_note: Distinct-identity counting on the ledger path

name: Tampered anchor payload or block header
baseline_note: Merkle inclusion + endorsed header binding

name: FIDEM device-id binding does not give per-device entitlement
baseline_note: Holder of class secret Kc answers for ANY claimed device identifier; identifier binding is not authenticated by a per-device key
